title: Excessive cognitive complexity
rationale: Complexity beyond what the task requires burdens understanding (marcus.simplicity, 4.24: do what is necessary).

remediation.suggestion: Extract helpers, reduce nesting, or document that the complexity is necessary.
remediation.drawbacks: Over-extraction can fragment logic; keep inherently complex algorithms together.

missingContext: Whether the complexity is sachlich necessary is not decidable statically; low-confidence signal.
